context: Mei and Aoi chat about a surprisingly busy day.
purpose: Casual register; adverbs (ちなみに/既に/それでも/さすが/あまりに) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今日は、あまりにお客さんが多かったね。
lines.en: Today there were far too many customers.
lines.style: bright tired barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お昼には、既に満席だったもんね。
lines.en: By noon it was already full.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それでも、笑顔で頑張ったね。
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm proud delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: さすが、あなたは慌てないね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm admiring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ちなみに、明日も忙しいみたいだよ。
lines.en: By the way, tomorrow looks busy too.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 既に、覚悟はできてるよ。
lines.style: soft determined woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あまりに疲れたら、休もうね。
lines.en: If we get too tired, let's rest.
lines.style: caring barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: それでも、明日も楽しもうね。
lines.en: Even so, let's enjoy tomorrow too.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
